_source: Cline gateways (api.cline.bot) + keyed clouds + OpenCode Zen (opencode.ai, keyed since 2026-09 — the old $0 keyless tier is gone). 'free_models' = $0 cost per token.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.note: api.anthropic.com — pay-per-token. 2026-09-24: Claude Opus 5.5 (Fable-5.1-class, $4/$20 per 1M); Fable 5.1 flagship at $10/$50 per 1M.

cline-usage.name: Cline (usage)
cline-usage.note: Rotating FREE promotions in Cline CLI/IDE (Cline account, quota-limited, rate-limited). Same auth as ClinePass.

clinepass.name: ClinePass
clinepass.note: Flat $9.99/mo subscription — 2-5x usage on open coding models; works with $0 credit balance. Reuses logged-in Cline CLI session when no key set.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.note: 2026-09-24: DeepSeek V4 — cheapest frontier-class ($0.14/$0.28 per 1M), 1M context, strong coding/agent tasks. Free tier available, check current status.

google.name: Google Gemini
google.note: Gemini API free tier is rate-limited and separate from the Google AI Pro subscription (Pro covers the Gemini app, not API calls). 2026-09-24: Gemini 3.8 Flash (Sep 2) is the newest stable Flash, 1M context. Image generation: gemini-2.5-flash-image (Nano Banana). Video: Veo via the Gemini API needs a billing-enabled key.

moonshot.name: Moonshot (Kimi)
moonshot.note: 2026-09-24: Kimi K3 — huge open-weight multimodal MoE, 1M context, native vision, strong long-horizon agentic coding, $3/$15 per 1M tokens. Key from platform.kimi.ai (OpenAI-compatible).

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.note: api.openai.com — pay-per-token. 2026-09-24: GPT-6 family (Astra flagship, Sol balanced, Luna lightweight).

opencode.name: OpenCode Zen
opencode.note: opencode.ai gateway — keyed since 2026-09 (the old $0 keyless tier is gone). Restored to the mesh at Dylan's request 2026-09-21.

xai.name: xAI (Grok)
xai.note: 2026-09-24: Grok 4.7 — xAI flagship for coding and long-running agentic work, 500K context, text+image input, configurable reasoning, $2/$6 per 1M tokens. Key from console.x.ai.

zai.name: Z.ai (GLM)
zai.note: 2026-09-24: GLM-5.3 Flash (MIT-licensed Flash edition, coding/agent-heavy) is the current default.
